presentation.description: Master the fundamentals of arcane magic until even your simplest spells set up stronger follow-up attacks and strike with greater force. Your schooling sharpens your Arcana knowledge, while an action point gives you a chance to correct a missed attack. You can pour extra power into familiar spells, reclaim an encounter attack that misses every target, and eventually turn a practiced encounter spell into a more punishing assault with longer-lasting effects.
